kind: Claude Code plugin with model output

pull_requests.title: feat(schedule): fall back to a cone 6 default for glazes not in the table
pull_requests.body: Potters often ask about a commercial glaze or a friend's recipe that the studio table does not list, and firing-schedule could only say it had nothing. When a glaze is not in the table, schedule.py now answers with the studio's cone 6 default schedule under the glaze's name and prints a line saying the default was used. firing-schedule tells the potter it is the default and to test fire a tile before a full load.

pull_requests.title: feat(skills): add firing-log to record each kiln firing
pull_requests.body: New skill: when a potter says they have loaded, started or finished a firing of a glaze, firing-log records it. schedule.py gains --json, which prints the glaze's schedule as one JSON object, and the skill pipes that into the new log_firing.py, which appends the firing to the log at KILNMATE_LOG (or ~/.kilnmate/firings.jsonl) and prints the firing's number. The reply opens with 'Firing logged:'.
